POP vs Gypsum for False Ceiling Design: Which is Better for Indian Homes?

Need a false ceiling for your home but wondering whether to choose POP or Gypsum? Well, that’s a pretty common concern amongst homeowners. Let’s take a look at what Livspace’s best interior designers in Mumbai recommend for Indian homes:

POP (Plaster of Paris) is custom-made on-site, can be crafted to create intricate details and designs, and fits perfectly for decorative lighting. POP offers a premium and luxurious look, making it ideal for bigger homes and villas. Although installing it can be a time-consuming and messy process.

Gypsum, the ready-made boards, on the other hand, offer a hassle-free and quick installation while creating a smooth and seamless finish. It’s ideal for modern homes where minimalism and easy maintenance are priorities. Gypsum is durable, offers fire-resistance benefits, and is also lightweight, making it the best choice for apartments and small homes.

The final answer is - for big homes where customization and a premium look are concerns, opt for POP, and for modern compact homes where quick installation is required, go for Gypsum.

featured_reviews.review_text: Was a 6 month journey with 99 windows, led by Mugdha and her team. Started off with design concepts and 3D reviews, as we werent sure ourselves apart from basic requirements, the 3D reviews did go back and forth till we were completely satisfied with what our house would look like. Have to commend Drishti who was very patient with the reviews. The team assisted us with selection of all ceramics, laminates, fabrics, hardware, plumbing fittings and were quite flexible with our limited schedules due to work. Though work did progress a bit slower than expected initially as my building was under construction with soft possession offered for fit outs, work hours were limited to 6pm, the team did engage additional manpower to have it completed and handed over on scheduled time. Minakshi towards the last couple of weeks was constantly following up to ensure work was done within the timeline and coordinating the delivery of items as per their schedule and rectifying any snags. The quotes provided were fairly accurate and any additional work requested due to material changes, the accounts team would timely provide the quotation to avoid last minute surprises.Would admit the process of getting your house renovated to your ideal dream home is a long and challenging journey and Mugdha and her team have made this journey easier and possible and the dream a reality. The photos of the flat don't justify the creativity and though put in when choosing the lighting.

featured_reviews.name: ABHIJEET PARIKH
featured_reviews.review_text:
When I bought my new home I was under dilemma with regards to my previous experience for carrying out Interior work. And trust me it is a Herculean task to buy abode in Mumbai and even bigger Zeus level task to get the right interior done with right esthetics.

In all this dilemma and thoughts, I meet Mugdha and her team of 99 Windows. Mugdha and her entire team are working like well lubricated friction free machine super smooth.

The journey started with exhaustive discussion during flat measurements stage itself. And during 3Ds stage Mugdha and Drashti gave lots of attention to our queries and requirements, several rounds of 3D discussion happened and then came their Quotation part, Mugdha was absolutely clear and transparent in her pricing and payment structures.

We found the quality of materials used in my flat were of much better quality then promised. I basically had given their team my clear requirement that Design should have great look, materials used should be robust and long lasting, and finishing should be such that Others should say Wow. I gave my entire flat on turnkey basis.

In all the above parameters Mugdha and her team were at par excellence. Not only did they meet all those parameters but they also meet these parameters within the stated budget and Handover of flat happened much before the planned timeline ( within 3.5 months after 3Ds freezed)

Looking at their love and dedication to their art and work we also made payments within their required timelines.

It would not be proper on my part to mention dynamic and energetic site supervisor Minakshi, she single handedly checked movement og labour without wasting time and helped us in curtain, sofa and dinning table chairs selection.

On my every site visit I saw 3D drawings taking shape right before my eyes, a flat becoming abode was surreal experience. We also remain committed with 3D drawings and never went for changes as everything was meticulously discussed.

We gave our full and complete trust to Mugdha and her team and they stood to that trust right till the handover of my abode. Learnt lot of things I would say 'A Journey worth taking'

Would have loved to upload pics but honestly speaking, its my Abode and when I enter it I am at peace so forgot take pictures as yet will surely add later

Regards
Abhijit Parikh

featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceptional Interior Design Experience with 99 Windows at our Borivali, Mumbai apartment.
Working with 99 Windows has been nothing short of a fantastic experience. From the very first discussion to the final handover, their approach reflected deep understanding, technical expertise, and a genuine passion for interior design.
What truly sets 99 Windows apart is their attention to detail and planning. Every element whether it was space optimization, material selection, or design flow was thoughtfully curated. They didn’t just focus on making the space look beautiful; they focused on how the space would be lived in. The layouts were intelligently planned to ensure maximum functionality without compromising aesthetics.The design intricacies were impressive. From perfectly aligned modular furniture to seamless finishes, every corner reflected precision. The material choices were premium and practical boards, laminates, hardware, fittings, and finishes were selected keeping durability, maintenance, and long-term use in mind. Their knowledge of textures, color palettes, and lighting balance clearly shows their experience in handling real homes, not just show designs. Another standout aspect was their execution quality. Timelines were respected, coordination between teams was smooth, and the site was always well-managed. Even complex detailing like custom storage units, concealed fittings, clean edges, and symmetry was executed flawlessly. There were no shortcuts taken, and that honesty in workmanship is rare. The team was also extremely responsive and transparent. Design suggestions were practical, changes were accommodated patiently, and every decision was explained clearly. This made the entire journey stress-free and collaborative rather than transactional. In today’s market, where many designers focus only on visual appeal, 99 Windows strikes the perfect balance between aesthetics, functionality, and quality craftsmanship. Their work reflects a deep understanding of modern living needs combined with timeless design sensibilities.
I would highly recommend 99 Windows to anyone looking for an interior designer who values quality, detailing, and client satisfaction. Their work truly transforms a house into a thoughtfully designed home.
— A very satisfied client
